vips.name: Lori Watson
vips.headline: Helping high-achieving women create greater clarity, confidence, and fulfillment through mindset and self-leadership coaching.
vips.about:
I've always been fascinated by the power of words. As a wife, mom of ten, entrepreneur, and longtime teacher, I've seen how the language we use influences our relationships, decisions, confidence, and experiences. That fascination eventually became a passion for helping women recognize the stories shaping their lives.

As a certified mindset coach, I approach mindset a little differently. I define mindset as the story we tell ourselves. We don't have to fake positivity, ignore difficult feelings, or convince ourselves that everything is wonderful. Instead, we can get curious about the stories we're telling, explore where they come from, and learn to choose language that supports the life we actually want to create.

I especially love working with high-achieving women who are capable, driven, and accustomed to carrying a lot. Sometimes the very qualities that help us accomplish great things also contribute to overwhelm, perfectionism, and frustration. Through deep coaching work and practical language tools, I help women develop greater clarity, confidence, and self-leadership. My goal isn't to make you less ambitious. It's to help you enjoy the life you're creating, even on the messy days. Because words matter—and changing your words can change your world.
vips.who: High-achieving women, entrepreneurs, professionals, and leaders seeking greater clarity, confidence, fulfillment, and self-leadership.

vips.name: Bessie Estonactoc
vips.headline: Spiritual Mentor and Quantum Journeys Hypnotherapist helping spiritual women, healers and entrepreneurs calm their nervous system and trust their intuition to create a life of peace, abundance and purpose.

I started as a Marriage & Family Therapist, supporting people through grief, trauma, relationship challenges and major life transitions. Over 20+ years of guiding women, I noticed something. So many of my clients understood their struggles but still felt stuck. Insight alone wasn't creating deep healing.

That led me to hypnotherapy, spiritual mentorship and intuitive work. Now I bring them together to help women move beyond understanding and into real change, by reconnecting with the wisdom and guidance they already have.

Let's raise our vibration and rise into the purpose our soul has been waiting to live.

events.title: Boundaries as Self-Love Workshop
events.desc:
Do you say yes before you’ve even checked how much energy you have?

When your energy is unpredictable, every yes costs more. So you overcommit on a good day, crash on the next one, and then feel guilty for canceling. Or you push through and pay for it later.

Boundaries aren’t about being harsh or shutting people out. They’re part of a self-love practice, a way of caring for yourself the way you care for everyone else.

In this free live workshop, you’ll build your Boundary Scripts: three ways to say no or “not right now,” one for each energy level, so you already know what to say before someone asks.

You don’t need to prepare anything. Camera optional, pajamas welcome. If you can’t make it live, sign up anyway and you’ll get the replay.
